# The reply to a voucher, opened again once joined, changes nothing: bob writes on where he was.

create alice g
join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
send bob g one
run
reopen bob g
state bob g
----
joined

send bob g two
run
show alice g
----
— a new group: adding a member's voucher code adds them
— reading the voucher
— added ~bob: they now read everything said in this group
bob: one
bob: two

refused
----
none
